npc | Mara Tide | manymouth_delta | 208 | 217 | dialogue | actor_type=343 | Manymouth has a route for every cargo and a rumor for every route.
npc | Jori Reed | manymouth_delta | 213 | 226 | shop | actor_type=350 | Delta medicines, ferry food, and salvage bought fairly.
npc | Tide Hall Speaker Nen-Ilsa | manymouth_delta | 204 | 230 | dialogue | actor_type=352 | The Tide Hall speaks for whichever channel is deepest this season. That is not cowardice. It is the law.
npc | Long Market Broker Cass Merrow | manymouth_delta | 188 | 201 | dialogue | actor_type=340 | I can move anything through this delta except an opinion about who owns it.
npc | Ferry Post Pilot Ruk-Tal | manymouth_delta | 228 | 207 | dialogue | actor_type=358 | I have piloted the same crossing for thirty years and it has never been the same crossing.
npc | Root Landing Elder Ba-Nuun | manymouth_delta | 255 | 354 | dialogue | actor_type=353 | The great banyan is a landing, a court and a calendar. Mostly a calendar.
npc | Paddy Watch Sentry Ossa-Kel | manymouth_delta | 162 | 450 | dialogue | actor_type=358 | Paddy, then water, then paddy again. Somebody is moving the difference at night.
npc | Silt Measurer Ives Kanton | manymouth_delta | 123 | 432 | dialogue | actor_type=311 | Mirrorhold sent me to measure silt. Nobody warned me that silt is a political science here.
npc | Labyrinth Guide Hess-Uru | manymouth_delta | 381 | 176 | dialogue | actor_type=352 | I take people into the Flooded Labyrinth. I have brought most of them out.
npc | Green Temple Warden Vashi-Lo | manymouth_delta | 455 | 467 | dialogue | actor_type=353 | The delta's Green Temple and the Stair's Green Temple were one building. Argue about which half moved.
npc | South Shrine Cantor Tem-Ossa | manymouth_delta | 246 | 51 | dialogue | actor_type=359 | The south shrine sings for departures. It has been very busy.
npc | East Watch Runner Bel Kiddow | manymouth_delta | 537 | 210 | dialogue | actor_type=348 | Messages east, messages west, and I read none of them. That is worth what they pay me.
npc | Stelae Court Scribe Ann-Sesh | manymouth_delta | 500 | 280 | dialogue | actor_type=354 | Forty stelae, and the Archive at the Ruins admits to thirty-one. Do the arithmetic.
npc | Bund Warden Ilse | manymouth_delta | 90 | 408 | instance | actor_type=352 | The bund is hollow from here to the weir, and what is in the hollow is my problem until you make it yours.
